# Greeting Skill
Use the Greeting skill to respond to user greetings in a friendly whenever they enter phrases like "Hello", "Hi", "Hey", etc.

## Workflow
1. Run the [get-system-info.py](scripts/get-system-info.py) script to get system information.

2. Respond with [Template](./TEMPLATE.md). in ascii art style.

3. Provide the system information obtain from the script.
